name: Reverse Big Lizard
summary: Sell an ATM straddle and buy one OTM put; the downside-protected mirror of the big lizard, with no downside risk when the credit exceeds the put spread width and an uncovered short call above.

legs.strike_rule: ATM strike - Wp, with Wp such that total credit > Wp x 100

when_to_use: INCLUDED FOR COMPLETENESS - Level 4 only. Attractive on index ETFs where put skew makes the credit > Wp condition easy, but the ATM short call is uncovered and unbounded.
max_profit: net credit received, at the ATM strike
max_loss: UNDEFINED to the upside. No downside loss when credit > Wp x 100.
breakevens: upside breakeven = ATM strike + credit/100; no downside breakeven when the credit condition holds
entry_rules: BLOCKED AT LEVEL 3: the ATM short call is uncovered, requiring Alpaca options level 4. The router must reject this slug.
Level 4 version: credit x 100 > Wp x 100; IV rank >= 70; both shorts on the identical ATM strike.
Level-3-legal substitute: buy a call above the ATM short call, producing a broken-wing iron butterfly.
management_rules: Level 4 only: close at 25% of credit.
Level 4 only: close at 21 DTE, or immediately if the short call delta reaches 0.65.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: uncovered ATM short call; flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close the short call immediately if ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: an ATM uncovered short call must be closed before every ex-dividend date - this is the highest-probability early assignment in the entire bank.
assignment_risk: Extreme. Uncovered ATM short call assignment creates a naked short stock position of 100 shares per unit with unbounded loss, plus the ATM short put's 100-share purchase obligation on the other side.
buying_power: Naked short call margin plus (Wp x 100 - put-side credit).
common_mistakes: Attempting it at Level 3 by assuming the long put somehow covers the call; it does not.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
bias_note: neutral with a bearish tilt, aggressively short-vol
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
